dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins starting from the mid-section and accelerating toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey to pale lavender-grey; mid-range pixel intensity consistent with sub-adult coloration.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter patches scattered across the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast linear white marks (rake marks/scars) visible on the mid-left and posterior dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Dark longitudinal shadow along the posterior midline indicating a prominent dorsal ridge; minor transverse indentation posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white linear rake marks of varying lengths and orientations across the dorsal surface, signifying healed epidermal abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Open, high-contrast dark oval aperture representing the blowhole at the anterior end of the visible dorsal plane.
